title: ShipmentCreateResponse
description: Canonical response after successfully creating a shipment with a carrier or platform. Carrier APIs (FedEx, UPS, DHL, and similar) most often return tracking numbers, service codes, delivery estimates, and labels. Platform-assigned identifiers and lifecycle timestamps are optional and may be synthesized when absent.

shipmentId.description: Platform- or integration-assigned shipment identifier. Rarely present in raw carrier create-shipment responses; may be derived from tracking when synthesizing a full canonical record.

externalId.description: Identifier in an external order or WMS system.

clientReferenceId.description: Client-provided reference echoed from the request.

masterTrackingNumber.description: Master tracking number for multi-piece shipments.

carrier.description: Carrier and service assigned to the shipment.

trackingNumber.description: Primary carrier tracking number. The most consistently available field across FedEx, UPS, DHL, and similar create-shipment responses.

trackingNumbers.description: All tracking numbers when multiple packages or legs exist.

items.description: Tracking number for a package or leg.

status.description: Canonical shipment lifecycle status. Carriers seldom return an equivalent status on create; platforms may default to created after a successful booking.

statusDetail.description: Human-readable detail or sub-status from the carrier.

timeWindowStart.description: Start of estimated delivery time window.

timeWindowEnd.description: End of estimated delivery time window.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for local delivery estimates.

labels.description: Shipping labels generated for the shipment.

packageId.description: Package identifier this label applies to.

url.description: URL to download the label when hosted remotely.

content.description: Base64-encoded label content when embedded inline.

trackingNumber.description: Tracking number printed on this label.

documents.description: Supporting documents (commercial invoice, customs, COA, etc.).

content.description: Base64-encoded document content when embedded inline.

name.description: Suggested file name for the document.

charges.description: Rated charges returned at creation time.

createdAt.description: UTC timestamp when the shipment was created. Usually assigned by the integrating platform, not returned by carrier create APIs.

metadata.description: Response-level metadata for tracing and integration.

extensions.description: Carrier- or integration-specific extensible response fields.
